lane: Backend/AI + mobile: Bản đồ số AI “Lời nhắn riêng” (Owner approved package B1-B8 on 25/11/2026)
goal: Build the code for the Owner-approved B1-B8 package of docs/proposals/NUMEROLOGY_AI_PRIVATE_MESSAGE_BACKEND_2026-11-25.vi.md: prompt numerology_private_message_system (vi+en), model route numerology_private_message (cheap non-reasoning model + 1 fallback, OpenRouter zdr / data_collection deny), feature switch default OFF with a strict fail-closed check, Premium quota 1 delivered message per Vietnam day with 2 failed-attempt allowance, a migration file that widens allowlists and seeds config rows only (not applied), the Edge Function ai-numerology-message (auth, switch, content-approval gate, Premium, quota before reading the body; strict body whitelist; server-side block text; output check inside the router so fallback can run), the mobile consent box and call wired to the “Lời nhắn riêng” card, Admin catalog entries, and Data safety / privacy wording drafts. The raw birth date is never sent (Owner allowed it only if it improved accuracy; research in the proposal shows it does not). Nothing is applied, deployed or switched on.
successCriteria: Request body accepted by the function is exactly the aiPayload.ts shape; any unknown key (name, birth date, etc.) is rejected with 400 and tests prove it.

Function order: auth -> strict switch (missing row or error = off) -> content approval gate -> Premium -> quota claim -> bounded body read; tests show the body is not read when the switch is off or quota is used up.
Function returns 503 content_not_approved while numerology-blocks.json review.status is not approved with a named reviewer.

Model output is checked inside generateWithModelRoute (JSON {message, blockIds}, <=120 words, blockIds subset of sent ids, banned words) so the fallback model is tried; on failure no canned text is shown as AI.
Migration only widens CHECK constraints / RPC allowlists and inserts route, switch (enabled=false) and prompt rows; no new table, no user data stored; a static SQL test asserts this.
Mobile: consent box states only numbers and content codes are sent and a turn counts only when delivered; feature_paused or content_not_approved keeps the card in “Sắp có”.
All checks listed in validationCommands pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL applied, no Edge Function deployed, no secret set or read, no switch enabled, no Play Console change: each is a separate Owner approval by hash.
No energy/credit deduction (none exists; Owner decided 15/11 to show no Nil number): consent text speaks of the daily quota only.
Prompt is not Admin-editable in this batch (prompt_feature_editable unchanged); feature not added to model campaigns.
numerology-blocks.json review status stays draft: approval needs a named human reviewer (B1).

impact.entryPoint: Khám phá -> Bản đồ số -> result -> “Lời nhắn riêng” card: button opens a consent box, then shows the message or stays “Sắp có” when the server says the feature is off.
impact.dataWrite: No new table. usage_events rows numerology_message_attempted / numerology_message_generated (no content); traces redacted strictly. Migration seeds config rows only.
impact.backendContract: New Edge Function ai-numerology-message and gateway path /ai/numerology-message; shared ai-request-guard gains an additive auth-only export.
impact.adminVisibility: Feature switch row, AI feature card, route editor entry, overview and workflow catalog graph for numerology_private_message.
impact.privacySafety: Only computed numbers and block ids leave the phone; raw birth date and names are rejected server-side; sensitive data class routes only; Data safety and privacy text drafted for Owner review.
impact.observability: Router traces with cost, usage events, safety events on blocked output.
impact.rollback: Switch stays off; revert the commit; migration includes rollback SQL comment removing seeded rows and restoring allowlists.
